concern_summary: This concern relates to the application's Offline Mode functionality, encompassing the management of the offline state, user notifications of offline limitations, and ensuring the accessibility of certain features like surveys when offline.

This concern addresses the overarching structure and management of the bottom tab navigator, including setting up routes, handling state changes for navigation, and ensuring the correct screens are shown based on navigation context.

This concern involves managing navigation actions related to tab navigation, ensuring users can move between tabs correctly and handle specific conditions associated with state changes in the navigation flow.

This concern focuses on the animation and focus management of tabs, ensuring that the correct tab state is reflected visually, facilitating proper keyboard navigation and managing routes accurately based on user actions.

This concern pertains to the bottom tab feature, facilitating navigation between various application sections, managing UI updates associated with user interactions, and displaying user-specific details.

This concern focuses on the user interface aspects of tabs, including rendering tab buttons, managing active/inactive states, and ensuring the correct tab content is displayed based on user interactions.

This concern addresses the internal logic handling navigation within the bottom tab, including back navigation, updating navigation states, and ensuring the correct routes and parameters are prepared for tab interactions.
This concern is related specifically to the chat tab functionality, determining the active state of the Chat Tab based on the presence of reports associated with a specific policy ID.
